services.title: Check engine light
services.blurb: Call {{phone}} to ask about check engine light.
services.detail: A code tells you where to start looking, not what's broken. We read it, test the circuit and show you the failed part before we quote the fix.
includes: Live data and road test when needed

services.title: Brakes
services.detail: Grinding, squealing, a soft pedal or a pull to one side: we measure everything and replace only what's worn.
includes: Pads, rotors, calipers, hoses and lines

services.title: Oil changes and maintenance
services.blurb: Call {{phone}} to ask about oil changes and maintenance.
services.detail: Conventional, blend or full synthetic with a multi-point inspection every visit, so small problems get caught early.

services.title: Engine and transmission
services.blurb: From a rough idle to a rebuild, diagnosed properly and fixed to last.
services.detail: Timing, gaskets, misfires, leaks and transmission service.

services.title: Suspension and steering
services.blurb: Call {{phone}} to ask about suspension and steering.
services.detail: We find the loose part and fix it.

services.title: Heating and A/C
services.blurb: Heat working before winter and A/C cold before summer.
services.detail: Leak detection, compressor and condenser replacement, blend doors and blower motors, and a proper recharge.

services.title: Batteries and electrical
services.blurb: No-starts, dead batteries, alternators and the gremlins other shops give up on.
services.detail: Starting and charging system tests, parasitic draw diagnosis, wiring repair and module programming.

services.title: Tires and alignment
services.blurb: New tires, rotations, repairs and alignments that make them last.
services.detail: We mount and balance all major brands, fix repairable punctures and align to factory spec.
